criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

Add name max_length=120, price and stock whole-naira/integer fields with stock default 0. Explain each field choice and add __str__. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Run python manage.py makemigrations inventory. Open the generated file and identify CreateModel, field types and dependencies in notes. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Run python manage.py migrate and showmigrations inventory. Save output showing the migration applied; explain the difference between generation and application. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

In manage.py shell create Pen price 200 stock 4. Close/reopen the shell and fetch the saved primary key. Record the persistent values. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add optional description using blank=True and a suitable default. Generate/apply a second migration and show the existing Pen record remains usable. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Run sqlmigrate for your first migration and annotate table creation and primary-key SQL. Explain why generated SQL depends on the configured database backend. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use a disposable project/database copy and apply migrations from empty. Verify Product can be created. Keep committed migration files and record the rebuild commands. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
